correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exponent calculation in the grading by cubic factors. The vertices of P=[0,2]^3∩{2≤a+b+c≤3} are the permutations of (2,0,0) and (2,1,0); its only non-generator lattice point is m=(1,1,1). Three generator differences (−1,1,0),(−1,0,1),(0,1,0) have determinant of absolute value 1, giving the full homogenized lattice with a degree-one generator. For an independent all-degree decomposition, list a,b,c tokens in three consecutive color runs and assign the stream cyclically to d bins. For (a,b,c)∈dP, each bin gets 2 or 3 tokens total and at most 2 of each color; its exponent is in P∩Z³. Every pair containing m (including m+m) has a replacement in A+A by the four permutation-type identities in the finding; checking their coordinates and iterating removes all occurrences for d≥2. Therefore the cone saturation differs only at (m,1), and the quotient is k(−1), killed by R_+. The graded localizations then give the same Proj. The radical of R_+S is S_+ since the added degree-one generator squares into R; Hochster's theorem and the exact sequence with k(−1) give precisely H¹=k(−1) below dimension four and depth 1 at the homogeneous maximal ideal. In the lattice count, two coordinate upper-bound violations cannot occur at total ≤3d. Subtract the three single violations and the region of total ≤2d−1 to obtain the binomial formula. Its third-degree polynomial gives normalized numerator 1+9t+6t², so the correction −t gives the displayed series, degree 16 and the stated Hilbert functions at d=0,1 and d≥2. The argument is characteristic-free and does not require executing the bundled finite checker (read, not run).

value.rationale: A canonical, independently motivated map from the Togliatti literature has a fully computed arithmetic defect. Identifying the unique absent section and the absence of every higher-degree defect explains how intrinsic normality coexists with failed projective normality and with depth one, and supplies exact invariants useful in comparing arithmetic behavior across Togliatti examples. This is not a claimed new general Cohen–Macaulay criterion or just a low-degree enumeration.
